title: GIG-4858: Isolate Worktree Stacks On The Shared Docker Network
description: `ngramx up` now disconnects every non-web container of a worktree stack from external shared Docker networks, so service names like `app` resolve only to that stack's own container and the login redirect loop no longer occurs.

test_plan.description: Two worktree stacks of one project resolve their own app container
steps: Run `ngramx up` in two worktrees of a project whose compose file joins `app` and `nginx` to an external shared network
Look for the 'Isolated from shared network(s)' line in each up output
Run `docker exec <stack>-nginx-1 getent hosts app` in each stack and confirm it returns that stack's own app container IP
Confirm only the nginx container remains attached to the shared network (`docker inspect`)

test_plan.description: Login works on both stacks with no redirect loop
steps: Log in on the first stack, then on the second, in either start order
Confirm /login and /dashboard do not redirect to each other on either stack
Run `ngramx up` again on an already isolated stack, or start one via Cortex Coder
Confirm no 'Isolated from shared network(s)' line is printed and the stack still works
